organization.name_ja: 株式会社ハーモニック

affected.note: Personal data of all 150,236 customers who registered or bought on the site up to 2020-11-14, plus data on 5,445 children provided for name engraving. Separately, card details of 28,700 customers used between 2020-11-14 and 2021-11-11 may have been stolen and misused.

summary.en: Catalog gift retailer Harmonick said attackers tampered with the payment application of its e-commerce site. Card details of 28,700 customers and personal data of 150,236 customers may have been leaked.
summary.ja: カタログギフト販売のハーモニックは、ECサイトの決済アプリケーションが改ざんされたと公表した。顧客2万8,700人のクレジットカード情報と、顧客15万236人の個人情報が流出した可能性がある。
